stdout:
List channel members. Use this tool to list information about channel members.

Usage:
  yutu member list [flags]

Examples:
# List all current members
yutu member list --mode all_current
# List members with limit
yutu member list --maxResults 10

Flags:
  -a, --hasAccessToLevel string   Filter members in the results set to the ones that have access to a level
  -h, --help                      help for list
  -n, --maxResults int            The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -c, --memberChannelId string    Comma separated list of channel Ids. Only data about members that are part of this list will be included
  -m, --mode string               listMembersModeUnknown, updates, or all_current (default "all_current")
  -o, --output string             json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings             Comma separated parts (default [snippet])
